verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents role-based access control, where privileges are granted to roles and roles to users. Object-level privilege grants are also implied by the clone docs: clones inherit grants on child objects such as tables. That covers the role and table-level part of the story, but nothing in the pack documents column-level masking policies or row-level access policies. Access History tracking which columns are read is auditing, not enforcement, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: masking policies, row access policies, column-level security docs, independent corroboration of multi-team isolation.
